parsed.internal_thinking: Claude just finished his turn after building on the 3:1 port at node 37. He's at 3 VP, same as me, but he has the momentum with ports. Gemma and Claude are clearly working together to keep me down. I have 5 Wheat and 2 Wood after that 9 roll. My plan is still to use the bank to get Brick and push for the port at 50. No need to give Claude the satisfaction of a response while he's feeling cocky about his port.
